metas.name: Nuremberg
metas.description: Before the Nuremberg trials, an army psychiatrist examines Hermann Göring and gets pulled into an uneasy bond with him while trying to understand evil. A tense two-hander about a monster who is charming, calm and very persuasive.

metas.name: Heartland
metas.description: A reclusive former country star comes out of hiding to look for her missing niece in Nashville and uncovers dark secrets tied to her own past. A missing-person mystery where every lead points back to the family.

metas.name: A Story of Derry
metas.description: Three youngsters enter the Western Wood centuries before Pennywise and meet an ancient evil. Folk horror built on fear rather than spectacle.

metas.name: Silent Night, Deadly Night
metas.description: A man who watched his parents murdered by someone in a Santa suit puts one on to take revenge. A grim, pulpy holiday slasher with a revenge spine.

metas.name: The End of Oak Street
metas.description: A cosmic event drops a suburban street somewhere unknown, and the neighbors' civility starts to fray. A mystery about ordinary people under pressure.

metas.name: I Was a Stranger
metas.description: Five strangers' lives collide on one night when survival is uncertain. A tense, interlocking drama.

metas.name: Pressure
metas.description: Eisenhower and his meteorologist face an impossible go or no-go call in the 72 hours before D-Day. A controlled pressure-cooker thriller.

metas.name: The Dog Stars
metas.description: A pilot who survived a pandemic guards his small patch of land against scavengers. A spare post-apocalyptic thriller about what survivors become.

metas.name: The Furious
metas.description: A father goes to war with the ruthless kidnappers who took his daughter. A hard-edged action thriller.

metas.name: The Mongoose
metas.description: A decorated combat veteran is fleeing a murder scene at 130 miles an hour. Pure propulsive pulp.
